book.name: Titu
book.title: Balua jaka pauli kwaka Titu Titu

content: Lakini weapa upalika kubola mabole ga sakaka.
Waabola akanalomi aseja abia nu uwesu ukulijemale beni, abia na malangu na abia bandu baapalika kupata isima, abia nu kuhobale kwasakaka, abia bunu upali wasakaka nu kuhinakali kwa sakaka.
Ahelahe waapwagila aka mbomba aseja abiya ahenga mahengu ga amboni palongi jaka Sapanga; biikuba bandu baakopake hindu yi isoli au biikuba alepi; Apalika kubola majambu gaamboni palongi jaka Sapanga,
kwi indela jenze biiwesa kwaabola aka kamwali kwaapala aka alomi babu na bana babu,

abiya baawesa kulijemale beni na bandu babunngungamali Sapanga, koni atunza sapi nyumba yabu, abia bandu baamboni na abiaa bandu babaajoane aka alomi babu, ili jwiipiti mundu kugatondo malobi gaka Sapanga.
Ahelahe wahingamakia akakombu abia awesa kulilongosa beni.
Mu majambu goti we wamweti gupalika gubiya lilenganu lukuhenga majambu ga amboni. Mu mabole gaku gulangia gagubola na wamwe gugajetakiya nu kugapwata.
Malobi gaku gakuba gasakaka na ganga ni likosa lokapi ili abaja baku apoalihamu, biipata sindu sokapi siliya su kutupwagi twepani.
Atumwa apalika kwaajoane akolongu babu na kwaatogulesa mu majambu goka wala biibisana nabu,
wala kujiba hindu yabu. Badala jaki apalika kulangi bombi ndi baamboni na baahobaleka nakanopi masoba goti ili mabole gaka Sapanga gabonikana gaasapi mu majambu goka.
Ndaba waamboni waka Sapanga goguleta wokopu kwa bandu boti gulangiwi pangwendu.
Wamboni hogu gutubola tukana maisa goti ganga kundengane Sapanga; tutama sukulilongosa twabeti, tutama maisa gaasapi palongi jaka Sapanga na sukunndengane Sapanga mu ndema gongo wa sajenu,
koni tubia tulendale lisoba lela la mbengalelu letuhobale, kipindi hekwiipitila ulumbi waka Sapanga nkolongu nu Nhokosi witu Yesu Kilisitu.
Jombi jilipia mweni ndaba jitu twepani ili jwatugombula kuhuma mu ubaja woti nu kutuhenga tubia twabandu baki mweni koni tubii sapi, bandu baatokule kuhenga gaamboni.
Ndienu waabola majambu haga na gutumia uwesu waku woti koni waahingamaki na kwaakanaki bandu baku babugujowane. Mundu jokapi jagulongama.
